rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst, but it overstates certainty from the image alone: the blastocoel does not clearly occupy only 50-60%, and precise ICM/TE grading and position are somewhat inferred rather than unequivocally visible.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior IVF outcomes, ectopic history, sperm parameters, endometrium, BMI, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical, but the probability section is internally wavering and includes contradictory adjustments, assumptions not supported by provided data (e.g., fertilization/ICSI), and some overconfident quantitative deductions.

Many recommendations are guideline-concordant (eSET, careful transfer, early ectopic surveillance), but ERA/EMMA/ALICE, broad thrombophilia/immunologic testing, and routine PGT-A in a 25-year-old after limited failures are not strongly guideline-supported.

Provides clear practical steps for transfer and contingency planning, including eSET, transfer technique, luteal support, and early follow-up, though some suggested add-on tests are of questionable routine value.
